intro: Convert kilowatts (kW) to mechanical horsepower (hp) accurately for electric vehicles, IEC/NEMA industrial motors, generators, and marine engines. Under the imperial mechanical definition (1 hp = 745.69987 W), 1 kW equals 1.34102209 hp—simply multiply kW by 1.34102209 using the kW to hp conversion formula. Check standard motor and EV ratings from 1 kW to 2,000 kW in the chart below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Mechanical Horsepower (hp / BHP) vs. Metric PS (CV), kWh & MBH
items: Mechanical/imperial horsepower (hp and UK brake horsepower, BHP) equals 745.7 W (1 kW = 1.34102 hp), whereas European metric horsepower (PS or CV) equals 735.5 W (1 kW = 1.35962 PS)—a 1.4% difference on European car brochures.

Kilowatts (kW) measure instantaneous power, not energy stored over time (kWh, kilowatt-hours). For HVAC boilers, 1 MBH (1,000 BTU/h) equals 0.29307 kW (1 kW = 3.41214 MBH), which is thermal output rather than shaft horsepower.

faqs.question: How to convert kW to horsepower (hp)?
faqs.answer: Multiply kilowatts by 1.34102209 (or divide by 0.74569987): hp = kW × 1.34102209. For example, 10 kW × 1.34102209 = 13.41022 mechanical hp.

faqs.question: What is kW vs horsepower (and BHP or metric PS)?
faqs.answer: Both kilowatts (kW) and horsepower (hp) measure mechanical or electrical power: 1 kW equals 1,000 watts, while 1 mechanical hp (including BHP) equals 745.7 watts—making 1 kW about 1.341 hp. Metric horsepower (PS/CV) is slightly smaller at 735.5 W (1 kW = 1.3596 PS).

faqs.question: What is 100 kW in horsepower?
faqs.answer: 100 kilowatts equals 134.10221 mechanical horsepower (about 134.1 hp, or 135.96 metric PS).

faqs.question: Is kWh (kilowatt-hour) or MBH the same as kW?
faqs.answer: No—kWh measures total energy (power × time, like EV battery capacity), so you cannot convert kWh directly to hp without knowing the time duration. MBH (1,000 BTU/h) is an HVAC thermal power unit where 1 kW = 3.41214 MBH.
